origin.api: aiohttp.web.UnixSite; each request.transport.get_extra_info(socket) must be AF_UNIX and getsockopt(SOL_SOCKET,SO_PEERCRED,12) supplies PID/UID/GID. No TCP listener/fallback or forwarded-header peer authority.
origin.ownership: Fixed socket path comes only from protected stage deployment config. Gateway UID996/GID981, parent0750 and socket0660; cloudflared gets group981 only. Retain exact socket device/inode and nofollow parent custody; refuse unowned collision.
origin.tunnel: Exact hermes-jarvis-mvp-tunnel.service, /etc/systemd/system/hermes-jarvis-mvp-tunnel.service, /usr/bin/cloudflared SHA256 aaeb2d7d0da3614634c7e03ab13487a1522c2e79165ed2929cfe23d5e95b326d. DynamicUser UID/GID are freshly observed, never hardcoded. Actual root-owned stage config pins post-change unit/config/argv and fixed unix ingress path; computed at deployment, not caller trust.
origin.startup: Gateway may bind/listen before tunnel exists. Every application request remains denied until actual current peer proof succeeds; no circular startup requirement.

inspector.semantics: Authenticate inspector IPC caller SO_PEERCRED against actual current fixed gateway unit MainPID/UID/GID/executable/start/boot, not UID alone. Independently resolve fixed tunnel unit MainPID, live PIDFD/start/boot/cgroup, executable hash and exact owned deployment unit/config/argv; compare request kernel peer tuple. Recheck before return. Canonical response digest excludes proof_sha256; response <=5s and same nonce/config/socket. No caller unit/path/hash or arbitrary operation. Peer fields are evidence, never authority. Failure denies.
inspector.bounded: Separate small current ingress readback from expensive native app tree inspection; retain existing native inspection guards at their existing admission/currentness points. No hash-walk bypass or completion timestamp reset.

sessions.api: StageGatewayPolicySessionAdapter receives a private StageAcceptedIngressObservation created only from this request socket and authenticated inspector result. admit/renew/heartbeat consume this exact observation; no bool/callback/raw mapping can authorize. Existing managed RootRemoteSessionClient unchanged.
sessions.jwt: Before all application bytes/input validate forwarded Access JWT with existing RS256/JWKS issuer/audience/email/expiry checks; reject ambiguous assertions and bind token fingerprint/principal/config. Accepted exact owned cloudflared peer plus this current request proves traversal through owned Access ingress, not continuous policy state.
sessions.heartbeat: POST /__stage_access_heartbeat, exact same host/origin, credentials included by browser, existing CSRF guards, bounded JSON <=2048 bytes with exact {session_id,nonce}. Server-issued cryptographic one-use nonce binds original stage record/JWT fingerprint/principal/config and deadline. Consume atomically before effect; successful accepted ingress+JWT returns only next nonce and bounded expiry. Browser schedules <=2s. Initial protected admission is first witness; no unauthenticated bootstrap or self-HTTPS probe.
sessions.lifetime: Record request-start time, never completion-restamp. Edge witness hard deadline <=5s and min original JWT/session deadline; every forwarding/input boundary checks it, watchdog closes exact WS no later than deadline. WS frames/pings cannot refresh. Session leases remain <=30s and original JWT expiry; explicit renewal through fresh protected HTTP cannot revive expired lease or change principal. Queue delay over freshness denies. Background timer throttling fails closed and requires fresh reconnect.
sessions.binding: Never parse, copy, store or log CF_Binding; browser sends HttpOnly cookie to Access automatically and Cloudflare strips it. Never disable binding, HTTPOnly, Access, TLS or sandbox.
